## NODE char_odysseus Character "Odysseus" "Odyssey" "book 9"
summary: King of Ithaca, son of Laertes and Anticleia, hero of the Trojan War and protagonist of the Odyssey.

## NODE char_penelope Character "Penelope" "Odyssey" "book 1"
summary: Wife of Odysseus and queen of Ithaca, known for her fidelity and cleverness.

## NODE char_telemachus Character "Telemachus" "Odyssey" "book 1"
summary: Son of Odysseus and Penelope, who searches for his father in the early books.

## NODE char_laertes Character "Laertes" "Odyssey" "book 24"
summary: Father of Odysseus and former king of Ithaca.

## NODE place_ithaca Place "Ithaca" "Odyssey" "book 1"
summary: The island kingdom of Odysseus on the Ionian coast.

## NODE place_troy Place "Troy" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: The walled city besieged by the Greeks for ten years.

## NODE event_trojan_war Event "The Trojan War" "Iliad" "book 1"
summary: A ten-year war between Greeks and Trojans, triggered by the abduction of Helen.

## NODE obj_bow Object "Bow of Odysseus" "Odyssey" "book 21"
summary: The great bow of Odysseus, used in the contest of the axes.

## NODE concept_xenia Concept "Xenia" "Odyssey" "book 9"
summary: The Greek code of guest-friendship, a sacred bond between host and guest.

## NODE char_polyphemus Character "Polyphemus" "Odyssey" "book 9"
summary: A Cyclops, son of Poseidon, blinded by Odysseus.
